entities.name: Richard T. Knowles
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Richard Thomas Knowles was a United States Army lieutenant general, who served as assistant commander of the 1st Cavalry Division and as commander of the 196th Light Infantry Brigade and Task Force Oregon during the Vietnam War.
